# STN Pro Supply Limited Partnership

> Industrial trading company in Bangkok, Thailand supplying maintenance, repair and operations (MRO) parts and hardware to factories in every region of Thailand.

## What we supply
- Bearings and power transmission: ball/roller bearings, belts and pulleys, chains and sprockets, couplings
- Fasteners and hardware: bolts, nuts, washers, anchors, rivets, threaded rod
- Pneumatics and hydraulics: cylinders, valves, fittings, hoses
- Electrical and control: sensors, switches, cables, motors, VFDs
- Tools and safety: hand/power tools, measurement, PPE, lockout/tagout
- Consumables: sealants, lubricants, tapes, abrasives

## Brands
60+ industrial brands including OMRON, SIEMENS, Mitsubishi, Panasonic, IFM, Pilz, Pepperl+Fuchs, Schneider Electric, ABB, Phoenix Contact, SICK, Keyence, Balluff, Autonics, Leuze, Turck, IDEC, HARTING, Hirose, WAGO, Oriental Motor, Carlo Gavazzi, Danfoss, Fuji Electric, Vishay, AirTAC, SMC, Norgren, Festo, FAG, NSK, NTN, SKF, Timken, IKO, INA, FYH, McGill, THK, Gates, Optibelt, Bando, Mitsuboshi, Tsubaki, Kana, Sealmaster, Martin, Flexco, ARI-Armaturen, Arita, Asahi, KITZ, Crane, Burkert, Mueller, NIBCO, Spirax Sarco, Endress+Hauser, WIKA, Winters, Nuova Fima, Watanabe, Sato, Vaqua, Kennedy, Matlock, Koken, Thor Hammer, Senator, Bott, Yamoto, Yaskawa.

## Coverage
Supplies factories in all regions of Thailand: Bangkok and vicinity, central and western Thailand, the Eastern Seaboard (EEC), northern, northeastern and southern Thailand. Delivery time depends on the stock location of each item and is confirmed with the quotation. On-site visits by appointment.

## Services
- MRO supply: reliable sourcing for maintenance, repair and operations; genuine parts and alternatives
- Procurement and sourcing: local and international purchasing, cross-brand matching, hard-to-find items
- Scheduled deliveries: flexible delivery schedules and blanket orders

## Quotation process (STNflow)
1. Request: send part names, specs or photos; the team identifies replacements for discontinued items
2. Source and compare: pricing and stock checked across 60+ partner brands, with alternatives for urgent needs
3. Digital quote: quotation delivered as a link (PDF downloadable instantly)
4. Delivery: scheduled or urgent
5. Follow-up and planning

## Languages
Website available in English (/en), Thai (/th) and Simplified Chinese (/zh).
